settings.title: Default agent

settings.description: The agent tool Legato starts when you name none. Unset, the workers' agent of swarms, else Claude Code.

settings.description: Detaches you from an agent's terminal after you attach to it from the TUI, written as ctrl+].

settings.description: The stretch of time each agent's activity bar shows, in the TUI and the web UI.

settings.title: Tell agents about each other

settings.description: Tells an agent when others work in the same folder. Off, no notices; agents can still message each other.

settings.title: Keep session history for

settings.title: Approval for a change
settings.help: auto runs at once; approve takes a tap; signed an enrolled device; verified a fingerprint or PIN too. Loosening it needs a signature.
settings.description: auto runs at once; approve takes a tap; signed an enrolled device; verified a fingerprint or PIN too. Loosening it needs a signature.

settings.title: Approval for a risky change
settings.help: Restarts, stopped agents, what runs here. default is signed once a device is enrolled, else approve; auto runs them at once.
settings.description: Restarts, stopped agents, what runs here. default is signed once a device is enrolled, else approve; auto runs them at once.

settings.title: Host operations
settings.help: Offers the Reeve a shell, file edits and systemd services on this machine, each as a change you approve.
settings.description: Offers the Reeve a shell, file edits and systemd services on this machine, each as a change you approve.

settings.title: Run host operations without asking
settings.help: Runs the Reeve's commands as your user at once, audited; as root they still need a verified approval. Turning it on needs a signature.
settings.description: Runs the Reeve's commands as your user at once, audited; as root they still need a verified approval. Turning it on needs a signature.

settings.title: Command timeout
settings.help: How long one host command may run.
settings.description: How long one host command may run.

settings.title: Output the Reeve reads
settings.help: The most of a command's output the Reeve is given. Longer output, or more than 40 lines, is cut to its first and last 20 lines, and the whole of it is kept in a file the Reeve can read.
settings.description: The most of a command's output the Reeve is given. Longer output, or more than 40 lines, is cut to its first and last 20 lines, and the whole of it is kept in a file the Reeve can read.

settings.title: When another Reeve messages
settings.help: With no session running: start one, ask you first in Attention, or refuse. Changed only with a signature.
settings.description: With no session running: start one, ask you first in Attention, or refuse. Changed only with a signature.

settings.title: Launch arguments
settings.help: Arguments added to the agent tool's launch command for a Reeve session.
settings.description: Arguments added to the agent tool's launch command for a Reeve session.

settings.title: Speak out loud
settings.help: Lets the Reeve speak on this machine's speakers. New sessions get the speak tool; turning it off mutes at once.
settings.description: Lets the Reeve speak on this machine's speakers. New sessions get the speak tool; turning it off mutes at once.

settings.title: Voice command
settings.help: Makes a line's audio, run as <command> "<text>" <out-file>: a script such as reeve-say.sh, or Piper.
settings.description: Makes a line's audio, run as <command> "<text>" <out-file>: a script such as reeve-say.sh, or Piper.

settings.title: Voice credential
settings.help: A credential Legato gives the voice command, as elevenlabs. Empty for a local voice.
settings.description: A credential Legato gives the voice command, as elevenlabs. Empty for a local voice.

settings.title: Credential variable
settings.help: The variable the command finds the credential in.
settings.description: The variable the command finds the credential in.

settings.title: Pause that ends a spoken turn
settings.help: How long you stay quiet before what you said is sent, from 0.3s to 2s.
settings.description: How long you stay quiet before what you said is sent, from 0.3s to 2s.

settings.title: Listen for a reply for
settings.help: How long the voice listens for your reply after the Reeve has spoken; 0s for a single turn.
settings.description: How long the voice listens for your reply after the Reeve has spoken; 0s for a single turn.

settings.title: Words as you speak
settings.help: Shows the words so far by transcribing about once a second. Turn it off when Whisper runs on a CPU or is shared.
settings.description: Shows the words so far by transcribing about once a second. Turn it off when Whisper runs on a CPU or is shared.

settings.title: Quiet hours
settings.help: When no line plays on this machine's speakers, as 22:00-07:00 local time; the Reeve writes instead. Empty, none.
settings.description: When no line plays on this machine's speakers, as 22:00-07:00 local time; the Reeve writes instead. Empty, none.

settings.title: Voice player
settings.help: Plays a line's audio file, named after it.
settings.description: Plays a line's audio file, named after it.

settings.title: Tell the Reeve once an agent is idle for
settings.help: How long a watched agent must stay idle, or busy only in the background, before the Reeve is told.
settings.description: How long a watched agent must stay idle, or busy only in the background, before the Reeve is told.

settings.title: Watch the agents the Reeve starts
settings.help: Watches every agent the Reeve starts or messages, so it hears when one waits, finishes or exits.
settings.description: Watches every agent the Reeve starts or messages, so it hears when one waits, finishes or exits.

settings.title: Wake the Reeve for its agents
settings.help: Starts or resumes a session when a watched agent needs the Reeve. Off, the news waits; on costs tokens while you are away.
settings.description: Starts or resumes a session when a watched agent needs the Reeve. Off, the news waits; on costs tokens while you are away.

settings.title: Projects
settings.help: The project keys the import search looks in. Empty, the projects saved here, else every project.
settings.description: The project keys the import search looks in. Empty, the projects saved here, else every project.
